$comment: Allowlist of what goes to the edge: by copy table — the columns and the attributes of the source. Anything not listed here does not go to the edge. The source for the v_edge_* views (10, 11), for the exporter’s serializer (an extra key means the batch is refused and the event export_whitelist_violation) and for the contract checks.

columns: replica table columns (edge); from: source of each value, “database.table.column” (column exists in DDL 01, 02, 05) or “computed: …” (calculated by a view or exporter); attrs: allowed keys of the source jsonb attrs.

views — export views: the copy table they feed; their columns are only the columns of that table and service_columns (needed by the exporter, they do not go to the edge). control_views — gate and settings views: they do not go into the copy.

Never: class, audience, hidden_at, deleted_*, purge_after, source_hash, source_ref, processor, confirmed_by, unlisted attrs, CRM entities, record_entities.role except mentioned for projects, org_reviews with people, open_check.

from.generation: computed: edge_state.gen generation (memory_control), returned by edge_gate_claim
from.external_access: computed: memory_control.external_access — enabled_at is set and disabled_at is empty

edge_people.$comment: Authors and participants of what is published (name, active) ∪ those who enabled “External access”. login_lc (lower(login)) and email (the login is the company e-mail) — only for those who enabled access, otherwise null; also only with ad_ok (the directory sweep confirmed the account). ad_ok_until — until when the sweep is still valid (only for those who enabled access, from v_people_ad_until by person_id; no check — the start of the epoch, that is, expired). The exporter always sends the field for everyone with external_access; null for such a person — the edge treats it as expired; no field — an exporter without expiry support, the edge does not check the expiry.
